messages:
Pri: hey team, pri here (started yesterday). my PR build is failing when pushing the image to GHCR with a `denied` msg. not sure whether it's token scope, docker config, or the fact this is a forked PR. who should i ping?

InfraBot: Buildkite failed: step `publish` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/pri-playground:pr-8
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/pri-playground'
```

Pri: i have GHCR_PAT set in the pipeline env (copied from my GitHub PAT). i gave it repo + packages when i created it. locally `docker login` worked.

Devon: welcome! :wave: couple of quick hypotheses: 1) the agent doing `docker login` is not the same user/process doing `docker push` (different DOCKER_CONFIG), 2) the build is running from a fork context so org app perms don't cover it, or 3) SSO/approved scopes missing for org members.

Pri: interesting — i see DOCKER_CONFIG set in the pipeline env to `/root/.docker-ci` for the publish step. my login command doesn't set DOCKER_CONFIG explicitly. could that matter?

Sasha: it can. if login writes creds to `~/.docker` but push reads `/root/.docker-ci/config.json` you'll get `Login Succeeded` but `denied` on push. also some Buildkite docker plugins execute commands in separate containers which don't share the same filesystem.

Pri: here's the publish step snippet from the pipeline: 
```
steps:
  - label: ":docker: build + publish"
    commands:
      - docker build -t $IMAGE:$BUILDKITE_COMMIT .
      - echo "$GHCR_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u $GITHUB_USER --password-stdin
      - docker push $IMAGE:$BUILDKITE_COMMIT
    env:
      IMAGE: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/pri-playground
      DOCKER_CONFIG: /root/.docker-ci
```

Devon: aha. because DOCKER_CONFIG is set at the step level it should apply, but if any plugin or earlier command runs in a different shell/context it might not. try forcing the DOCKER_CONFIG for login and push explicitly, e.g.:
```
DOCKER_CONFIG=/root/.docker-ci echo "$GHCR_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u $GITHUB_USER --password-stdin
DOCKER_CONFIG=/root/.docker-ci docker push $IMAGE:$BUILDKITE_COMMIT
```
this ensures both commands use the same docker config path.

Pri: good call. before i rerun, is there a quick way to verify on the failing build that the login and push are using different configs? the raw logs showed `Login Succeeded` then `denied` on push.

Sasha: paste the log snippet and i'll scan. sometimes the login output includes the path to config or you can add `ls -la $DOCKER_CONFIG` right after login to confirm the file is present and contains `auths`. you can also add `docker --config /root/.docker-ci info` to see which client config is in use.

Pri: log excerpt: 
```
+++ echo "[secure]"
+++ docker login ghcr.io -u pri --password-stdin
Login Succeeded
+++ docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/pri-playground:pr-8
denied: requested access to the resource is denied
```

Devon: that matches the same-situation symptom. try adding an `ls -la /root/.docker-ci` and `cat /root/.docker-ci/config.json | sed -n '1,40p'` (masking the auth) right after login in a temporary debug run. also confirm whether the pipeline uses a `plugins: docker` block, which spawns isolated helper containers that won't see `/root/.docker-ci` from the main step.

Pri: ok i'll add the debug lines and switch to the inline DOCKER_CONFIG for login/push, then re-run.

Buildkite Agent: build #62 started - step `publish`

Pri: pushed a debug build. log now shows the `/root/.docker-ci/config.json` exists and contains an `auths` entry after login, but the push still failed with `denied`.

Sasha: given that, check whether the image name is actually under the org namespace and that your PAT has SSO approved. forks sometimes run under a different git remote and the push target may not match your credentials' allowed scope. run a local test without org context to ensure the repo name is correct: `docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/pri-playground:debug-test` (you already said local login worked, but confirm the repo is owned by org).

Pri: local push to the same name worked, so repo name and token are fine. i think it's the fork/buildkite context. how do we handle fork PRs?

Devon: for fork PRs we usually either: (A) require contributors to push images to personal namespaces (e.g., `ghcr.io/principal/pri-playground`) for CI, or (B) run the publish step only on mainline branches (not fork PRs), or (C) have CI maintainers re-run the publish step with a trusted token. For onboarding, infra can temporarily add your user to `ci-testers` so the org app covers the fork builds.

Pri: i don't need prod publishing for my sandbox PRs — option B sounds fine. i'll change the pipeline to gate publish on `BUILDKITE_PULL_REQUEST_BASE` == `main` for now.

Buildkite Agent: build #62 failed (publish step skipped by condition)

Pri: switched the pipeline to skip publish on fork PRs; build now passes for tests that don't push. leaving a note in onboarding doc: "If you see `Login Succeeded` but `denied` on push, validate DOCKER_CONFIG alignment and fork vs org token coverage (org app vs PAT + SSO)." thanks for the pointers! cc @Devon @Sasha for a short walkthrough later. :smile:
